learning_outcomes.text: To give the knowledge of the design and the use of cutting tools and their proper choice for concrete application.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, the importance of cutting tools.
Cutting materials (high speed steels, sintered carbides).
Design elements of cutting tools - cutting part.
Design elements of cutting tools - clamping and other parts.
Cutting tools for difficult to cut materials and non-ferrous materials.
Cutting tools use and their grinding.
Introduction, geometry of cutting tools, examples, calculation.
bibliography: Kvasnička, I. - Slavík, V. - Štajnochr, L.: Obráběcí nástroje. Skripta ČVUT, 1998, 98 s.
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
